name: Shelly Plug Gen4 (US)

radios.note: Shelly lists Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and Zigbee, and says the plug can act as a Zigbee router. Shelly's spec line reads 'Matter over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Matter over Zigbee'.

matter.note: CSA certificate CSA250D9MAT45099-24 (02/10/2025, firmware 1.3.0-s2, product ID 0x1852). The CSA page's description text mentions the Shelly 1PM Gen4, which looks like a copy error.

apple_home.note: Shelly says it works with Apple HomeKit through its Matter certification. Apple's own accessory list was not checked. Needs an Apple home hub for remote control and automations.

google_home.note: Shelly lists a Google Home integration exposing the On/Off trait. It is also Matter-certified, so a Google Matter controller is another route.

alexa.note: Shelly lists an Alexa integration exposing the Power Controller capability. It is also Matter-certified.

smartthings.note: Shelly lists a SmartThings integration with Switch and Power Meter capabilities. It is also Matter-certified.

home_assistant.note: Official Shelly integration, which says it supports all four Shelly device generations. Matter and Zigbee are other routes.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi device with Wi-Fi access-point setup; no bridge needed.

localControl.note: Shelly lists local control, locally stored schedules and local scripting; Home Assistant's Shelly integration talks to the device on the local network.

energyMonitoring.note: Built-in power meter. It also has a light sensor for illuminance reporting.

maxLoadWatts.note: 15 A / 1800 W, with overheating, overvoltage, overcurrent and overpower protection.

summary: The Shelly Plug Gen4 (US), model S4PL-00116US, is a Matter-certified Wi-Fi smart plug that also has Bluetooth and Zigbee radios. It measures power and is rated 15 A / 1800 W. Shelly lists its own integrations for Alexa, Google Home and SmartThings, and Home Assistant's official Shelly integration supports it.
caveats: Apple Home works through Matter only; Apple Home needs a home hub for remote control and automations.
